detail.longDescription: Nerding before I’m even out of bed this morning. Yesterday I built out the equivalent of my # GitHub Enterprise Server PR reviewer for my # Forgejo instance. After being awake for 5 minutes this morning I realized that I need to exclude # Renovate PRs from being reviewed. I had # Codex fix that, commit and push the code. Then I SSH’d into my # ArchLinux box, pulled the update and built a new # Docker image. All from my # iPhone . I love it! 🤓 :archlinux: :forgejo:
